name: Caisse regionale de Credit Agricole Mutuel d'Ille-et-Vilaine Societe cooperative
summary: Caisse régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel d'Ille-et-Vilaine Société coopérative provides banking services in France. It offers bank accounts and cards related services; saving solutions; insurance products, such as vehicle, personal, and home insurance; real estate loans; and consumer credit comprising personal, auto, student, and apprentice loans. The company is headquartered in Saint-Jacques-de-la-Lande, France.
